Copper Oath.Mechanic: Your first successful hit in each fight deals +40% damage, or +120% against a Champion or Unique. Misses don't use it up; it is lost when the fight ends.
Copper Oath.Flavour: He had no throne, so he stole the right to strike first.

Thornshot.Mechanic: Your first hit in each fight always Staggers, then 15% chance on hit (at most once every 6 s): the enemy's next attack comes 25% of its attack interval later.
Thornshot.Flavour: Whoever takes a second step in this forest has already taken the first arrow.

Stitched Furrows.Mechanic: Each time you eat (preserved food counts), the enemy is poisoned for 8% of the HP healed per second for 6 s. Up to 3 stacks; a new stack at most once every 1.5 s.
Stitched Furrows.Flavour: Hobb's pockets hold things older than last year's harvest.

Ringbark Reprisal.Mechanic: 100% of the damage you reflect is stored and added to your next successful hit, then the pool resets. The pool is capped at 150% of your normal max hit, and reflected damage is never reflected again.
Ringbark Reprisal.Flavour: The forest counts back every axe it has taken.

Hoarder's Prism.Mechanic: When a monster drops an item whose drop chance is 5% or less, gain +25% damage for 90 s and your rare item chance is 15% higher (2% a kill becomes 2.3%). Triggering again refreshes the time; it does not stack.
Hoarder's Prism.Flavour: Qivra sees every shiny thing once and never lets it go.

Comb Knuckles.Mechanic: After you eat (preserved food counts), your next 3 attacks get +25% damage and -15% attack interval; at most once every 8 s, does not stack. Also +15% food preservation chance.
Comb Knuckles.Flavour: Every six blows, one drop returns to the hive.

Mire Throat.Flavour: The bog gets in through the deepest wound.

Snarestep.Mechanic: When every hit of an enemy attack misses on its own accuracy roll, gain a Silk Tension charge (max 1): your next successful hit deals +35% damage. Blocks, immunity and item dodges don't count; your own misses don't spend it, and it is lost when the fight ends.
Snarestep.Flavour: The web catches not the prey, but the wasted swing.

Thicket Trophies.Mechanic: Killing a Champion or Unique gives a trophy of 1-2 of its affixes for 90 s of online combat: Hasted -12% attack interval; Colossal +20% max hit points and +8% damage; Warded +15% max hit points; Armoured -12% damage taken; Vampiric +5% lifesteal; Enraging +15% damage and -8% attack interval while you are below 60% HP. Up to 3 trophies (a 4th replaces the oldest) and matching affixes stack, capped at -40% attack interval, -35% damage taken, 8% lifesteal and +60% max hit points.
Thicket Trophies.Flavour: Every bone swaying on Vuldrek's branch was once another hunter's pride.

Caravan Seals.Mechanic: Every 3 normal kills (counted across fights) readies a Passage Seal (1 at most). When a Champion or Unique fight starts the seal is spent, and your first 5 successful hits on that enemy gain +30% crit chance; misses don't use them and unused ones are lost when the fight ends.
Caravan Seals.Flavour: Four lost caravans, one open road.

Veil Rebuttal.Mechanic: Magic only. 15% chance that an enemy attack does no damage at all, and you strike back with a free hit of your spell (it cannot crit and triggers no items).
Veil Rebuttal.Flavour: Selkris lets no blow go unanswered.

Oathlocked Plate.Mechanic: Above half your hit points you take 15% less damage; at half or below you deal 15% more damage.
Oathlocked Plate.Flavour: There is no room in this breastplate for a second oath.

Skytoll.Mechanic: When your hit kills an enemy, its overkill damage plus 8% of that enemy's max HP is stored (1 charge). When the next enemy spawns it takes that as physical damage, capped at 40% of its max HP; ward and damage reduction apply, and the charge is lost when combat stops.
Skytoll.Flavour: The pass's debt does not die with the debtor.

Breaker Hooves.Mechanic: Every 6 successful hits in a fight remove one damage-over-time effect from you with all its stacks: Poison first, then Bleed, then Burn. With none on you, the wave heals you for 2% of your max HP instead.
Breaker Hooves.Flavour: The sea does not take everything; Nacreon chooses what to leave.

Sovereign Diadem.Mechanic: The first time in a fight your hit drops a living enemy from above 50% HP to 50% or below, gain -25% attack interval for 4 s. Once per fight; damage over time or a killing blow won't trigger it, and the bonus ends when the enemy dies.
Sovereign Diadem.Flavour: The guards take the first half; the sovereign takes the rest.

Lantern Veil.Mechanic: 20% chance on hit to Burn the enemy for 4% of that hit's damage per second for 4 s. Killing an enemy that carries a Poison, Bleed or Burn grants a Ration Light charge (max 1, kept between fights): your next meal is not used up.
Lantern Veil.Flavour: Those who follow Selyth's light never run short of rations.

Wreckshot.Mechanic: Grows with your Champion and Unique kills while you wear it (kept with the character); each step adds to the ones before: 25 = +10% damage, 50 = +6% crit chance, 75 = -8% attack interval, 100 = +25% damage against elites, 125 = +1 loot roll per elite kill.
Wreckshot.Flavour: Dask gives the first shot to the sea and puts the second on his tab.

Gatebreaker.Mechanic: +40% damage while the current enemy is a Champion or Unique, on top of this item's +35% max hit. Breaking one opens the gate: your next fight starts with +40% damage for 10 s.
Gatebreaker.Flavour: In Kelsarin, a gate is just a wall that hasn't taken its first blow.

Cavern Bastion.Mechanic: Every 5th enemy attack that lands at least one direct hit deals 50% less direct damage (added to your other damage reduction, like the game's own); the count carries between fights. Full misses and damage over time don't count, and a multi-hit attack counts once.
Cavern Bastion.Flavour: The mountain's first four answers are echoes; the fifth is stone.

Pinnacle Diadem.Mechanic: Your first successful hit in each fight also takes up to 2 hits of the enemy's ward (besides its normal damage) and gives you 2 hits of ward for 10 s, or 4 if the enemy had any ward.
Pinnacle Diadem.Flavour: Every stone in Ydrak's crown was once someone else's last refuge.

Goremantle.Mechanic: Each kill grants a Hunger stack (max 10) giving +3% damage each (max +30%); stacks carry over to new enemies. Eating any food clears all stacks, but lifesteal and other healing do not.
Goremantle.Flavour: The more ribs it gathers, the hungrier it grows.

Thunder Traces.Mechanic: Every 4th successful hit in a fight records 70% of the HP it removed (capped at 15% of the enemy's max HP). 2 s later, if the same enemy is still alive, that amount strikes again; it cannot crit.
Thunder Traces.Flavour: Teyr's claw has passed; its thunder has yet to settle the score.

Starbound Mantle.Mechanic: Each successful hit grants an Orbit stack after it lands (max 20), each giving +2% damage to later attacks (max +40%). Misses neither grant nor remove stacks; all stacks reset when the fight ends.
Starbound Mantle.Flavour: In Vaelis's sky, no star rules alone.

Usurper's Circle.Mechanic: Copies the bonuses (not the equipment stats) of the ring in its paired ring slot (1-2, 3-4, 5-6). Unique rings are not copied; two Usurper's Circles copy nothing.
Usurper's Circle.Flavour: Thulvek mimics not your face, but the worth you leave behind.

Soulstring Quiver.Mechanic: Ranged only. Never used up when you shoot. Every 5th successful ranged attack (every 4th against elites) fires a free extra shot at 75% damage that can crit.
Soulstring Quiver.Flavour: Every arrow Qor looses comes back with a soul beside it.

Fourfold Writ.Mechanic: Magic only. Every 4th spell keeps its runes and prayer points and opens the next seal in order: 1) +40% damage on that spell; 2) Burn for 3% of your max hit per second for 5 s; 3) heal 5% of your max HP; 4) the enemy's next attack deals 50% less damage. The cycle is kept between fights.
Fourfold Writ.Flavour: Ithrek's four hands renew four seals; the book never forgets whose turn it is.

Threevoice Cleaver.Mechanic: After every 2 successful hits, your next attack deals +35% damage and the enemy's evasion is 30% lower for it (a miss does not use it up; it starts over each fight).
Threevoice Cleaver.Flavour: Three throats, one blade, and none of them ever agreed.

Root-Shear Claws.Mechanic: 25% chance on hit to Bleed for 30% of the hit's damage over 4 s (max 5 stacks); each bleed tick can crit. Hitting a bleeding enemy refreshes your bleeds, but direct hit damage is -20%.
Root-Shear Claws.Flavour: It cut the roots first, so nothing could hold on.

Thornstep Spinecoat.Mechanic: The damage you reflect hits 2.5 times (it can crit) and has a 25% chance to Bleed for 30% of it over 4 s (3 stacks at most); these hits trigger no other items. Your own attacks deal 10% less damage.
Thornstep Spinecoat.Flavour: Tavio never stopped dancing; the thorns kept time.

Tollkeeper Greaves.Mechanic: Your HP cannot go above 50% of your max HP (auto-eat still uses your full max HP). 15% of the direct damage you take is given back and taken over 4 s instead; that delayed damage cannot kill you.
Tollkeeper Greaves.Flavour: Everyone pays the toll. Some just pay it slower.

Sunken Volley.Mechanic: Each attack fires a second arrow: both deal 60% damage. The second uses one more ammo and rolls its own hit and crit.
Sunken Volley.Flavour: Two arrows to a string, drowned and still drawn.

Twin-Eye Longwatch.Mechanic: +60% attack interval, but your shots almost never miss and hit for at least 80% of your max hit. The first shot of each fight is a guaranteed crit.
Twin-Eye Longwatch.Flavour: One eye to find you, one eye to never miss.

Conclave Spire.Mechanic: Magic only. At the start of each fight your spell's element switches to the enemy's weakness (the spell's effects and rune costs stay; nothing changes against Neutral enemies). Hits with elemental advantage deal +15% damage on top of the normal bonus.
Conclave Spire.Flavour: Four voices argue; the right one always wins.

Sanguine Liturgy.Mechanic: Spells keep their runes (you still need one cast's runes in the bank); each cast costs 3% of your current HP instead (never below 1 HP). With magic, +1% damage per 2% of missing HP (max +30%).
Sanguine Liturgy.Flavour: Runes are a poor man's blood.

Plungeheart Tusk.Mechanic: Every 5th hit freezes the enemy for 1 turn (count kept between enemies), and frozen enemies take +40% damage. When your freeze ends on a living enemy it shatters for 6% of its max HP (max 200% of your max hit, halved vs elites); enemies that can't be frozen become Brittle for 1 turn (+20% damage taken) and take a 3% shatter instead.
Plungeheart Tusk.Flavour: Cold enough to stop a heart, sharp enough to break it.

Hollow Harvest Crown.Mechanic: Your max hit points are 35% lower, and you gain +6 ward. Your ward is full at the start of each fight, regains 1 every 4 s (not for 2 s after you are hit), and eating gives 1 back (once in 2 s).
Hollow Harvest Crown.Flavour: Empty inside, and harder for it.

Veil-Antler Reprieve.Mechanic: Once every 3 minutes of fighting (the wait is kept when you stop or restart): when you drop below 20% HP or take a fatal blow you survive, heal 40% of your max HP, enemy attacks do no damage for 3 s, and you gain +30% damage and -15% attack interval for 15 s.
Veil-Antler Reprieve.Flavour: The stag walked out of the veil once. It can show you the way.

Threefold Decree.Mechanic: The combat triangle always favours you, with One Style's class too (which otherwise turns the triangle off): you get its advantage (+10% max hit and less damage taken) against every enemy and never its penalty.
Threefold Decree.Flavour: Urzath ruled three ways at once, and every way was his.

Ringleader's Tally.Mechanic: Every equipment set you wear at least 2 real pieces of counts as one piece more (wizard sets, Dawnsteel, Meteorite, Ironsteel...). Sets with 0-1 pieces get nothing, and the extra piece never starts another set.
Ringleader's Tally.Flavour: He never counted the pieces, only the sets.

Amber Reservoir.Mechanic: Combat potions in your toolbelt are never used up, and their stat bonuses (damage, accuracy, evasion, protection, healing...) are 1.5 times; chances, intervals and durations stay the same.
Amber Reservoir.Flavour: A drop of venom, kept forever in gold.

Dune-Vizier Wrappings.Mechanic: Prayers cost 50% fewer points (at least 1) and their bonuses are 30% stronger. Each kill gives 15 prayer points.
Dune-Vizier Wrappings.Flavour: The sand keeps prayers the way it keeps the dead.

Oathbound Gauntlets.Mechanic: When an on-hit effect of your gear (bleed, burn, stun, wither...) does not happen on a hit, it rolls once more: a 20% chance becomes 36%.
Oathbound Gauntlets.Flavour: An oath sworn twice is never broken.

Abyssal Beacon.Mechanic: Twice the chance of Champions and Uniques (with your other elite bonuses, at most 2.5 times). Every elite gets one more affix and +20% HP, and drops one more Rare (3-affix) item.
Abyssal Beacon.Flavour: Light in the deep does not guide. It calls.

Scrapwind Treads.Mechanic: On a Slayer task each task monster you kill gives +1% damage and makes your rare item chance 1% higher (up to +30%, so 2% a kill becomes 2.6%), and task monsters come 30% faster. When the task ends the stacks go and you keep 1 token (1 at most): your next elite kill drops one more Rare (3-affix) item.
Scrapwind Treads.Flavour: Baskor walked where the hunt was, and took what was left.

Dreamtide Orb.Mechanic: Every 4th hit puts the enemy to sleep for 1 turn (at most once every 8 s per enemy); immune enemies become Drowsy instead and their next attack deals -25% damage. Your first hit on a sleeping or stunned enemy deals +80% damage and cannot miss.
Dreamtide Orb.Flavour: She sleeps; the tide does the rest.

Ossuary Magazine.Mechanic: Ranged only. Never used up when you shoot. Every 4th ranged attack deals double damage.
Ossuary Magazine.Flavour: The bones always come back to the quiver.

Brood-Sign Grips.Mechanic: Every 3rd hit summons a spiderling (max 3) that lives 8 s and attacks every 2 s for 20% of your max hit, using your accuracy. Spiderlings cannot crit or trigger items.
Brood-Sign Grips.Flavour: A thousand eggs, and every one hatches hungry.

Hemal Palimpsest.Mechanic: Magic only. Every 5th spell is followed by a free echo: one more hit of your spell (its own hit roll, can crit).
Hemal Palimpsest.Flavour: Written over and over, in the same red ink.

Mirage Astrolabe.Mechanic: Your spell imbuement's bonuses are multiplied by 1.8, or by 2.7 on every 6th spell.
Mirage Astrolabe.Flavour: It points where the stars should be.

Caravan Warcloak.Mechanic: Melee only, by stance: Stab +30% accuracy; Slash 20% chance on hit to cause Bleed; Crush stuns for 1 turn on every 4th successful hit (once in 8 s). Nothing in Block stance, or with ranged or magic.
Caravan Warcloak.Flavour: Zafir's road had three turns: stab, slash or crush.

Twin-Lurker Fangs.Mechanic: On hit, 25% chance to strike once more for 50% of a normal hit (it rolls its own accuracy and critical hit, and triggers nothing else).
Twin-Lurker Fangs.Flavour: Skarn never needed a second blade. He just liked the second wound.

Bell-Yoke Wand.Mechanic: Magic only. Every 3rd spell you cast (misses count) is followed by a bell strike for 35% of a normal hit of your spell (it rolls its own accuracy and critical hit, and triggers nothing else).
Bell-Yoke Wand.Flavour: The herd came home to the bell. So did everything else.

Resin Hoard Ring.Mechanic: When food restores your hit points, you gain 2 more hits of ward for 6 s: the next 2 hits you take go through it and do less damage. At most once every 8 s; your other ward stays.
Resin Hoard Ring.Flavour: Ploxx kept everything it swallowed. This ring was the least sticky part.

Divide Sentinel's Aegis.Mechanic: Melee only. Every 3rd enemy attack that hits you readies one Answer (only one is kept; a new one at most every 8 s from when the last was readied): your next successful melee hit deals +40% damage and has a 20% chance to stun for 1 turn.
Divide Sentinel's Aegis.Flavour: The mountain does not dodge. It waits, and then it answers.

Talon of the Divide.Mechanic: After each successful hit your critical hit chance is rolled again, on its own: on a success you gain an Edge (3 at most; each new Edge renews them all to 15 s), +10% critical damage each. With 3 Edges your next attack is a sure critical hit with +80% critical damage in all (the Edges' +30% and 50% more), and the Edges are spent.
Talon of the Divide.Flavour: Kethra struck once to mark you, and once more to finish it.

Divide-Fang Howler.Mechanic: On hit, 25% chance to gain 1 stack of the game's Rage (Rage from anything else counts too). Each stack: +2% damage, up to +10%. At 5 stacks your next successful hit howls: it uses up all your Rage and stuns the enemy for 1 turn. A howl at most every 10 s; while it waits your Rage stays and keeps its bonus.
Divide-Fang Howler.Flavour: Kaul's pack is long dead. The howl still answers.

Veinbound Chalice.Mechanic: +5% lifesteal. Lifesteal healing your full hit points cannot take is stored as Blood (up to 20% of your max hit points). When you drop below 40% hit points, all the Blood heals you at once. While the Blood is full you deal +15% damage.
Veinbound Chalice.Flavour: Sareth never spilled a drop. She saved them for later.

Barrens Hush.Mechanic: Each successful hit, on its own, has a 12% chance to Blind the enemy for 4 of its turns and an 8% chance to Wither it for 6 of its turns (the game's own Blind and Wither). You deal +15% damage to an enemy that is Blinded or Withered, from any source; it does not add up when it has both.
Barrens Hush.Flavour: You never hear Osvyr coming. That is the point.
